titleEn: Review merchant support and trust requests

undo.note: a decision is final; the merchant can file a new request (an appeal after a 24 hour cooldown); the audit row stays

operatorReason.text: staff decide suspension appeals, protected brand address claims and store limit grants; a merchant can file these but never decides them

ar: مين بيقرر في اعتراضي على الإيقاف؟
مين بيوافق على طلب العنوان المحمي؟

steps: Super admin: open Support and trust requests, read the request, press Resolve (a store limit request takes the new limit) or Reject
edgeCases: Rejecting an appeal starts a 24 hour cooldown
Resolving a store limit request sets the owner cap (3 to 20) and never lifts the paid plan allowance
